requirements.title: UCOBOUND argument restrictions
requirements.definition: COARRAY shall be a coarray, allocated if allocatable, with rightmost part-ref of nonzero corank for multi-part designators; DIM shall be an integer scalar in the range one through corank with a present associated allocated corresponding actual; KIND shall be a scalar integer constant expression.

pending.UCOBOUND-COARRAY-coarray-any-type: OUT OF SCOPE: exercising a conforming COARRAY actual requires coarray fixture support, which this single-image suite excludes by user decision.
pending.UCOBOUND-allocatable-COARRAY-allocated: OUT OF SCOPE: allocated allocatable coarray state is coarray-dependent and not covered by local single-image plans.
pending.UCOBOUND-rightmost-part-ref-nonzero-cora: OUT OF SCOPE: part-ref corank designators require coarray entities and are outside this suite's source fixtures.
pending.UCOBOUND-DIM-integer-scalar-in-corank-ra: OUT OF SCOPE: observing DIM validity for UCOBOUND requires a coarray actual and corank-bearing execution context.
pending.UCOBOUND-DIM-corresponding-actual-presen: OUT OF SCOPE: this facet is tied to a coarray inquiry call and no local-coarray plan is registered.
pending.UCOBOUND-KIND-scalar-integer-constant-ex: OUT OF SCOPE: the KIND result can only be observed through a UCOBOUND call on a coarray actual, excluded here.

requirements.title: UCOBOUND result characteristics
requirements.definition: The result is integer with KIND-selected or default kind, scalar with DIM present, and otherwise a rank-one array of size equal to corank n of COARRAY.

requirements.title: UCOBOUND final upper cobound identifies the last-image selector
requirements.definition: The final upper cobound is the final cosubscript in the list selecting the image whose index equals the number of images in the current team.
